senses.gloss:
m. (-पुः)
An enemy.
E.
रप to speak, to abuse, aff. उ, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Killing a foe.
f. (-नी)
A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.)
E.
रिपु an enemy, and घातिन् destructive.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Victorious.
m. (-यः)
Name of a king.
E.
रिपु, जि to conquer, खच् aff.

f. (-ता)
Hostility, enmity.
E.
रिपु, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रिपुत्वं.

mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं)
Vile, bad, wicked.
E.
री to hurt, Uṇādi aff. र, the vowel made short, and पुट् augment.
